Name: Lumisteria Hybrid Custom Flowers
Author: Lumisteria
Description:
This mods is adding several hybrids for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7110]Lumisteria Flowers and Crops[/url], using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6577]Hybrid Crop Engine[/url]. Grow the flowers and in the right conditions, hybrid can start appearing in adjacent tilled ground near the mature flowers.
Includes Korean translation by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/users/48693548?]Kaya[/url].

Discover different hybrids for the following crops :
[spoiler]
- Forget-Me-Not
- Iris
- Hollyhock
- Lavender
- Foxglove
[/spoiler]

How to obtain the hybrid ?
The first hybrid can be obtained by growing the base crop near itself. But the next hybrid will usually have slightly complex requirement ! Each day when the right condition are met, there is a small chance an hybrid crop will appears in the ground.

What are the chances ?
[spoiler]
The chance is 10% for an hybrid to appears.
[/spoiler]

How many hybrid can be discovered ?
[spoiler]
There are 3 hybrid for each kind of flower currently supported, making a total of 15 new crops.
[/spoiler]

Why growing hybrid ?
They are pretty and give you more decoration options. Last stage hybrid is usually a bit more valuable than the base crop. They also are different to obtain than classic crops so if you like collectioning stuff and search rare plants, this is for you.
